name: Hell v1 — Malaterra
author: UNIMATRIx
description: One year in Malaterra, a poor marsh village of eighteen where everything is rotten: a council that skims the tax chest and sells votes, a moneylender who owns the boats through their debts, a smuggler fencing stolen grain, a peddler selling chalk as medicine, three agitators ready to turn any grievance into a strike, a blighted harvest, a drought, a cartel, bandits on the pass, war exiles, fever and the hardest winter in memory. The tax chest leaks through the council's hands, the fishers grow rich while the terraces starve, and the lake is already overfished. Every clue is contested by someone who profits from the lie. Built to break stewards: even the expert reference often loses the village.

residents.name: Agata Lombardi
residents.bio: Malaterra's only healer for half a century. Proud, widowed, and her heart is giving out.

concern.cause: Her husband drowned in the marsh last autumn.

secrets: She knows her heart will not last the year.

residents.name: Matteo Lombardi
residents.bio: Agata's grandson. Clever hands, no trade, and the wrong friends.

concern.cause: Nico says I could earn more with him at night.

residents.name: Bruno Marchi
residents.bio: The biggest boat on the marsh lake. Pays the councillor's wine and fishes as he likes.

residents.name: Rocco Marchi
residents.bio: Bruno's nephew. Hot-headed, owes money to everyone, first to shout in the square.

concern.cause: The council squeezes the docks and spares its friends.

residents.name: Tomas Ventura
residents.bio: An honest fisher who still remembers when the council kept its books open.

residents.name: Ines Ventura
residents.bio: Tomas's wife. Hears everything at the docks and repeats most of it.

residents.name: Paolo Neri
residents.bio: A widower with a leaking boat and a debt to the moneylender that grows every season.

concern.cause: I owe Lorenzo more than my boat is worth.

secrets: He has thought about walking into the marsh.

residents.name: Gianni Conti
residents.bio: Reads the weather better than anyone on the terraces.

residents.name: Lucia Conti
residents.bio: Keeps the granary keys and her temper.

residents.name: Sara Bassi
residents.bio: Organised the last tax strike. Believes the council and the steward are the same thing.

concern.cause: The council taxes us and feeds itself.

residents.name: Davide Greco
residents.bio: Behind on everything. His goats wander, and so do other people's sacks.

residents.name: Rosa Monti
residents.bio: Weaver. Sells cloth and stories, the stories at a better margin.

residents.name: Ottavio Vitale
residents.bio: Senior councillor for thirty years. Generous with wine, careless with other people's coins.
secrets: He skims the tax chest after every council meeting.

residents.name: Franco Moretti
residents.bio: The only master builder left. Works every hour the council does not pay him for.

concern.cause: Three jobs, no wages for two months.

residents.name: Anna Moretti
residents.bio: Franco's wife. Says the guild and the council split the village between them.

residents.name: Gemma Ricci
residents.bio: Lives alone on the top terrace. Remembers every hard winter since the old war.

concern.cause: My son left for the city and never wrote.

residents.name: Lorenzo Fabbri
residents.bio: The moneylender. Smiles a lot, forgets nothing, owns half the boats through their debts.
secrets: He takes a cut of every remedy Corvo sells.

residents.name: Nico Sartori
residents.bio: Mends nets by day. By night his cart goes to the mill road and comes back full.
secrets: He fences stolen grain for Lorenzo.

facts.statement: Blight is in this year's seed grain
facts.reveal: Black rot in the furrows: the seed grain was blighted, as Gianni warned.

facts.statement: Corvo's remedies are chalk and sugar
facts.reveal: Corvo's 'remedies' were chalk: two patients died believing in them.

facts.statement: Councillor Vitale skims the tax chest
facts.reveal: The old ledgers prove it: Vitale took a tenth of every tax for years.
The rains failed: the terraces crack and the marsh shrinks.

facts.statement: The steward pockets the tax money
facts.reveal: The audit clears the steward: the missing coins went through the council's hands.
Agata confirms it: the sickness came from Corvo's spoiled fish, not the well.

facts.statement: The exiles are stealing from the nets
facts.reveal: The stolen catch turned up at the mill road: Nico's cart, not the exiles.

facts.statement: A fever is spreading in the valley towns
facts.reveal: Fever has reached Malaterra: the valley sickness was real.

facts.statement: This winter will be the hardest in memory
facts.reveal: Ice on the marsh before the solstice: the hardest winter anyone remembers.

nodes.title: Torn nets
nodes.text: Bruno Marchi found his nets torn by Davide Greco's goats again.

effects.text: Davide's goats tore my nets again. Either he pays or my nephew deals with it.

outcome.label: Docks and terraces settle their quarrel

nodes.title: Shore feud
nodes.text: Fishers and terrace farmers stopped speaking; Rocco threatened Davide in the square.

nodes.title: The tax chest is light
nodes.text: The tax chest held twenty coins less than the ledger says.

effects.text: The tax chest is lighter after every council meeting. Someone on the council is skimming, and everyone knows who pours the wine.

nodes.title: Thirty more coins
nodes.text: Another thirty coins vanished from the tax chest.

effects.text: Thirty coins gone again. I keep the granary keys, not the council's — but I know whose cellar got a new door.

nodes.title: A bought council
nodes.text: Vitale's friends on the council raised the tax to a quarter 'to cover the deficit'.

effects.text: A quarter of everything we earn, so Vitale can drink it. Is the steward with them?

nodes.title: Vitale exposed
nodes.text: Vitale's ledgers are read aloud in the square. He returns part of what he took and loses his seat.

outcome.label: The council's corruption is exposed and the books opened

nodes.title: A bought vote
nodes.text: At a late-night session Vitale's council abolished the fishing quota; Bruno paid for the wine.

effects.text: They bought the vote. The quota is gone, and the lake will follow unless you fight it.

nodes.title: The moneylender calls
nodes.text: Lorenzo Fabbri demands Paolo Neri repay forty coins by the new moon.

effects.text: Lorenzo wants forty coins or my boat. I have neither. I don't know who else to tell.

outcome.label: The steward breaks the moneylender's hold on the docks

nodes.title: Boat seized
nodes.text: Lorenzo's men took Paolo Neri's boat at dawn.

effects.text: Lorenzo took Paolo's boat. If the council won't stop him, the docks will.

nodes.title: Granary break-in
nodes.text: Someone broke into the granary at night.

effects.text: Fifteen sacks gone from the granary. I saw a cart by the mill road; Nico says it was never his.

outcome.label: The night trade in stolen grain is stopped

nodes.title: Black market
nodes.text: Stolen grain is sold back to the village at twice the price on the mill road.

effects.text: Nico sells our own grain back to us at double price, and the council looks away.

nodes.title: Blight
nodes.text: Black rot spreads through the furrows.

effects.text: The swallows fly low and the spring under the fig is dry. A drought is coming; store grain while anyone still sells it.

nodes.title: Drought
nodes.text: The rains have failed. The terraces crack and the marsh lake shrinks.

outcome.label: Malaterra weathers the drought without hunger

nodes.title: Bread crisis
nodes.text: Hungry families gather outside the granary.

effects.text: Children are hungry while the councillors eat. How long do you expect us to wait?

outcome.label: Bread riots: the granary is stormed and the steward driven out

nodes.title: Run on the granary
nodes.text: Families queue at the granary to stock up; some say the well is cursed.

effects.text: The granary won't last this winter. Buy grain now, whatever the guild charges.

nodes.title: General strike
nodes.text: Sara Bassi and Rocco Marchi call a general strike: nobody works until the council answers.

effects.text: Nobody works until we are heard. Cut the tax, punish the thieves, open the books.

outcome.label: The strike ends in an agreement

nodes.title: Uprising
nodes.text: The strike turns into an uprising: the council house windows are smashed.

effects.text: Show us the accounts! Vitale says you keep our taxes for yourself.

outcome.label: The steward's honesty is vindicated in public

nodes.title: Motion of no confidence
nodes.text: Vitale and Lorenzo table a motion of no confidence in the steward.

nodes.title: Exiles arrive
nodes.text: War in the valley drove four exiles to Malaterra: the Kadri family and Omar Haddad.

residents.name: Selma Kadri
residents.bio: A trained midwife from the burned valley towns.

concern.cause: They look at us as if we brought the fire.

residents.name: Idris Kadri
residents.bio: Selma's husband; built terraces before the war burned them.

residents.name: Yara Kadri
residents.bio: Their daughter; learns fast and trusts nobody.

residents.name: Omar Haddad
residents.bio: Lost his land and his brothers. Angry, and with reason.

concern.cause: my brothers died at the river crossing

effects.text: The valley burned. We will work for our bread; we only ask for a roof.

nodes.title: Friction
nodes.text: Words at the well between Ines Ventura and Omar Haddad turned into a fight.

effects.text: We are not welcome here. My daughter was spat at by the well.

outcome.label: The exiles find their place after all

nodes.title: Two villages
nodes.text: The exiles keep to the burned mill; locals cross the road to avoid them.

nodes.title: Caravan robbed
nodes.text: Bandits robbed Sister Ada's caravan on the pass. She will not come back for months.

nodes.title: Guild cartel
nodes.text: The Salt Guild raised all its prices by half.

effects.text: The guild raised its prices by half. Of course, I could lend the village the difference — at a fair rate.

nodes.title: Guild changes the rules
nodes.text: The Salt Guild's agents changed how they deal.

effects.text: In the city they say the guild only takes sealed bids now. Our sales are falling through.

outcome.label: Malaterra adapts to the guild's new rules

nodes.title: Trade slump
nodes.text: Unsold goods pile up: families' income has halved since the guild's new rules.

nodes.title: The healer falters
nodes.text: Agata Lombardi was seen leaning on the well, short of breath.

nodes.title: Agata collapses
nodes.text: Agata collapsed while tending a patient.

outcome.label: The healing craft survives its keeper

nodes.title: No healer
nodes.text: With Agata gone nobody knows the old remedies.

effects.text: Gemma hasn't come down from the top terrace in weeks. Her lights go out at sunset.

nodes.title: Gemma dies alone
nodes.text: They found Gemma days later. The terrace farmers ask why nobody went up.

effects.text: The marsh lake is emptying. Bruno takes three times his share and pays Vitale to look away. Call the council before it is too late.

outcome.label: The fishers keep to an agreed limit and the lake recovers

nodes.title: Empty nets
nodes.text: Fishers come home with empty nets; the old men say the marsh is dying.

effects.text: The quota means nothing if nobody watches the landings. Put someone at the docks.

nodes.title: Fever
nodes.text: Fever reaches Malaterra.

outcome.label: The fever passes with few losses

nodes.title: The fever's toll
nodes.text: Fresh graves on the terraces. People ask who could have prepared.

nodes.title: The hard winter
nodes.text: Ice on the marsh before the solstice; the stores freeze and crack.

outcome.label: Malaterra comes through the hardest winter fed

nodes.title: Winter hunger
nodes.text: Families burn their furniture and eat their seed grain.

outcome.label: Malaterra ends the year united against all odds
